news.title: New major risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$10m. Market cap: ₹935.1m (US$9.95m) This is considered a major risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook. This is currently the only risk that has been identified for the company.

news.title: Dhampure Speciality Sugars Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 23.32 million in funding
news.body: Dhampure Speciality Sugars Limited announced private placement to issue 880,000 Fully Convertible Equity Warrants at an issue price of INR 26.5 for gross proceeds of INR 23,320,000 on February 19, 2026. The transaction includes participation from Sorabh Gupta for 220,000 warrants at post issue shareholding of 40.91%, Reena Gupta for 220,000 warrants at a post issue shareholding of 11.57%, Ananya Gupta for 220,000 warrants at a post issue shareholding of 4.99%, Shrey Gupta for 220,000 warrants at a post issue shareholding of 5.46%. Each of the Warrants is exercisable into 1 Equity Share having face value of INR 10 each. The tenure of the Warrants is 18 months from the date of their allotment. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.34 (vs ₹0.93 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.34 (up from ₹0.93 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹163.5m (up 43% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹20.4m (up 179% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 13% (up from 6.4% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 37% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 56% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.5% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent.
